WHATWG HTML named character references

Source: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/entities.json
Specification: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/named-characters.html

The named character reference data has been converted into a Rust UTF-16 table
by scripts/generate-rust-html-entities.py for the application's HTML string codec.
